context: Mei and Aoi recount a lucky near-miss.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (一瞬/幸い/気味/そうそう/寄せ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: さっき、一瞬ヒヤッとしたの。
lines.en: Earlier, I had a split-second scare.
lines.style: animated barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle concerned delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 棚が倒れ気味で、一瞬焦ったの。
lines.en: A shelf was about to tip, and I panicked for a second.
lines.style: lively barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 幸い、けがはなかったのね?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、幸い無事だったよ。
lines.style: relieved barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そうそう、棚は壁に寄せた方がいいよ。
lines.en: Oh right, you should push the shelf against the wall.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そうそう、壁に寄せておくね。
lines.en: Right, I'll push it to the wall.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 一瞬の油断が、危ないもんね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm caring closing delivery throughout
